subject: Aids to Navigation - Northern Grand Banks
text:
Aids to Navigation - Northern Grand Banks
Two-legged ODAS mooring deployed. 
The two-legged mooring extends from the seabed to the surface.
The first anchor position is 46 49.297N 048 02.115W and is marked with a yellow spherical wave buoy with a yellow navigational light with flash pattern 5 flashes every 20 seconds and AIS.
The second anchor position is 46 49.470N 048 02.220W and is marked with a orange high-flyer buoy with a yellow navigational light with flash pattern 5 flashes every 20 seconds and radar reflector.
Caution.
